title: Citizens’ delegation protests outside Environment Ministry over pollution

ai.summary: A citizens' delegation including AISA president Neha Bora protested outside Delhi's Environment Ministry demanding urgent action on air pollution and the 'Right to Breathe', after sending a letter to the Environment Minister on November 12.

facts.claim: A citizens’ delegation, including All India Students’ Association (AISA) president Neha Bora, staged a protest outside the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) office in Jor Bagh on Monday
facts.quote: A citizens’ delegation, including All India Students’ Association (AISA) president Neha Bora, staged a protest outside the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) office in Jor Bagh on Monday

facts.claim: The protest followed a letter sent by the delegation to Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav on November 12, seeking an urgent meeting to discuss worsening air pollution and demand solutions
facts.quote: The protest followed a letter sent by the delegation to Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav on November 12, seeking an urgent meeting to discuss worsening air pollution and demand solutions

facts.claim: We want to meet the Environment Minister and ask what the Ministry has done in the past one year to curb pollution in the city
facts.quote: We want to meet the Environment Minister and ask what the Ministry has done in the past one year to curb pollution in the city

facts.claim: India is facing a severe public health emergency. As many as 22 of the world’s 25 most polluted cities are in India
facts.quote: India is facing a severe public health emergency. As many as 22 of the world’s 25 most polluted cities are in India

ai.background_note: The protest occurred in Delhi, where air quality has been a major issue with AQI levels exceeding 400 and reaching up to 800 in other cities.
